title: First-Principles Theory of Anharmonicity and the Inverse Isotope Effect in Superconducting Palladium-Hydride Compounds
one_line: SSCHA首次用于超导体系，解释PdH反常同位素效应，α=-0.38
why: 本方向方法学起点，把SSCHA和超导Tc计算第一次结合

title: High-Pressure Hydrogen Sulfide from First Principles: A Strongly Anharmonic Phonon-Mediated Superconductor
authors_short: Errea, Calandra, Pickard, Nelson, Needs, Li, Liu, Zhang, Ma, Mauri
one_line: H3S中非谐性把λ从2.64压到1.84（30%），谐波下Tc随压强降低而非谐后几乎不随压强变化
why: 氢化物非谐研究的奠基性论文

title: Second order structural phase transitions, free energy curvature, and temperature-dependent anharmonic phonons in the self-consistent harmonic approximation: theory and stochastic implementation
one_line: 推导自由能对质心位置二阶导数（Hessian）的解析公式，给出二阶相变/动力学不稳定的严格判据
why: SSCHA自由能Hessian方法学核心论文，是判断'谐波虚频是否真不稳定'的理论基础

title: The stochastic self-consistent harmonic approximation: calculating vibrational properties of materials with full quantum and anharmonic effects
authors_short: Monacelli, Bianco, Cherubini, Calandra, Errea, Mauri
one_line: SSCHA方法与python-sscha/CellConstructor代码的标准综述与引用文献
why: 了解代码能力边界和标准用法的首选文献

title: Quantum crystal structure in the 250-kelvin superconducting lanthanum hydride
authors_short: Errea, Belli, Monacelli, Sanna, Koretsune, Tadano, Bianco, Calandra, Arita, Mauri, Flores-Livas
one_line: 量子核效应把LaH10 Fm-3m相稳定下限从谐波预测的230GPa推到约130GPa，与实验~140-150GPa吻合
why: 量子涨落决定晶体结构的经典论文

title: A chemical bonding based descriptor for predicting the impact of quantum nuclear and anharmonic effects on hydrogen-based superconductors
one_line: iCOBI化学键描述符：对称键合环境降低Tc，非对称键合环境升高Tc，是目前唯一的廉价方向性预测工具
why: 直接回答'能否廉价估计非谐修正'这一关键问题

title: Anharmonicity and Nonadiabaticity in Hydride Superconductors
one_line: 引入A_λ和R_V两个无量纲诊断量，H3S/YH6/YH9需要非谐+非绝热联合修正，PdH/D/T强非谐但绝热
why: 本方向最新（2026-08）的系统性诊断框架，直接连接D1方向

title: Anharmonicity and Coulomb pseudopotential effects on superconductivity in YH6 and YH9
one_line: 非谐性使λ 2.24→1.71，但Tc仍高估，缺口来自μ*的频率截断重整化未被充分处理（作者已由主会话核实：Ding, Chen, Shi，北大 Junren Shi 组）
why: 证明非谐性问题和库仑赝势问题（D2方向）是耦合的

title: Quantum lattice dynamics and their importance in ternary superhydride clathrates
one_line: MLIP+SSCHA首次系统应用于三元超氢化物笼形结构
why: MLIP加速SSCHA方法线的代表性早期论文

title: Efficient modelling of anharmonicity and quantum effects in PdCuH2 with machine learning potentials
one_line: MLIP+SSCHA用于PdCuH2的非谐/量子效应建模

title: SSCHA-based evolutionary crystal structure prediction at finite temperatures with account for quantum nuclear motion
one_line: SSCHA+进化算法+MLIP做有限温度晶体结构预测，通用势Mattersim-5m能给出正确结构排序但精度不够定量
why: 直接回答'MLIP加速后SSCHA能否进入高通量'

title: Displacive quantum critical point in superconducting hydrides: The case of H3S
one_line: PIMD+MACE势画出H3S的Im-3m/R3m位移相变相图，QCP在~134GPa，属4D Ising普适类
why: 把量子核效应/非谐性和量子临界点文献连接起来

title: Full Temperature-Dependent Potential and Anharmonicity in Metallic Hydrogen: Colossal NQE and the Consequences
one_line: 金属氢中发现'巨大'核量子效应，暗示声子图像本身可能失效，提出GID理论框架（作者已由主会话核实）
why: 氢主导体系中非谐性的极端案例

title: Search for thermodynamically stable ambient-pressure superconducting hydrides in the GNoME database
one_line: GNoME数据库筛出490个立方氢化物，用SSCHA验证LiZrH6Ru（常压Tc~17K）动力学稳定性

title: Anharmonic theory of superconductivity and its applications to emerging quantum materials
one_line: 综述非谐退相干在软模不稳定系统、非晶固体、高压金属超导中的作用
why: SSCHA之外的非谐超导理论框架

title: Nonadiabatic and Anharmonic Effects in High-Pressure H3S and D3S Superconductors
one_line: H3S/D3S在160/200GPa下非谐+顶点修正联合计算

one_line: PIMD力引擎i-PI的原始方法论文

one_line: 同位素效应与BCS理论的经典背景综述（agent 原填 ID 缺 cond-mat/ 前缀，已修正）
